EvolutionBranch] -->|FeedbackLoop| A Modules Seed Module (updated: v3.1 “seed-only + trace”) 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Linkage Scaffold SeedLayer: PrimaryTheme → informs FundamentalLaw ConceptualSeed → inspires SensoryLens ValueSpectrum → polarises CoreDuality (Axis 1) and RelatedDuality (Axis 2) CoreDualityName → labels CoreDuality (Axis 1) (trace only; do not store poles here) 3 · YAML Schema (tool-friendly) SeedModuleV3_1: version: 3.1 PrimaryTheme: # one-sentence essence ConceptualSeed: # short paradox / image ValueSpectrum: # "X ↔ Y" (testing band, not necessarily the axis poles) SensoryLens: # dominant sensory filter CoreDualityName: # trace label for Axis 1 handed off to Duality/Law SeedLens: # optional: Architect|Mirror|Weaver|Oracle|Creator 4 · Usage Notes PrimaryTheme may be poetic, but must stay one sentence. SeedLens is optional; when present it biases downstream interpretation. Seed does not define FundamentalLaw or duality poles anymore; it only seeds them via linkage. 5 · Illustrative Example SeedModuleV3_1: PrimaryTheme: "All forms yearn toward their own reflection." ConceptualSeed: "In every mirror, a doorway." ValueSpectrum: "Clarity ↔ Obscurity" SensoryLens: "Perception of reality arrives first as echo, then object." CoreDualityName: "Order ↔ Flux" SeedLens: "Mirror" Duality & Law Module (updated: v2.4 “depth + 4 law-questions”) 1 · Canonical Lexicon Canon note (why “informed by”, not “equals”): the manual’s Seed example sets ValueSpectrum to “Clarity ↔ Obscurity” while CoreDuality is “Order / Flux.” 2 · Linkage Scaffold SeedLayer.PrimaryTheme → FundamentalLaw SeedLayer.ValueSpectrum → CoreDuality (Axis 1) + RelatedDuality (Axis 2) FundamentalLaw + (each pole) → CentralQuestions (4) 3 · YAML Schema DualityLawModuleV2_4: version: 2.4 FundamentalLaw: # single declarative sentence :contentReference[oaicite:16]{index=16} CoreDuality: # Axis 1 poleA: # word / phrase :contentReference[oaicite:17]{index=17} poleB: RelatedDuality: # Axis 2 poleC: # word / phrase :contentReference[oaicite:18]{index=18} poleD: central_questions: # NEW (4 = one per pole; each must reference the law) - id: "Q-A" pole_ref: "CoreDuality.poleA" question: "" - id: "Q-B" pole_ref: "CoreDuality.poleB" question: "" - id: "Q-C" pole_ref: "RelatedDuality.poleC" question: "" - id: "Q-D" pole_ref: "RelatedDuality.poleD" question: "" validation_rules: - "Each central_questions[*].question must explicitly reference FundamentalLaw (quote or tight paraphrase)." - "Each question must be framed from the perspective of its pole." 4 · Implementation Notes Immutability: changing FundamentalLaw spawns a branch universe. Echo rule: every module from Cosmic → Characters references at least one pole. Lens bias: a lens may bias toward a pole but never deletes the opposite. CentralQuestions recurrence: every Scene/Node should engage ≥1 question (adherence hook). 5 · Illustrative Example DualityLawModuleV2_4: FundamentalLaw: "Reflection precedes manifestation." CoreDuality: poleA: "Order" poleB: "Flux" RelatedDuality: poleC: "Stasis" poleD: "Becoming" central_questions: - id: "Q-A" pole_ref: "CoreDuality.poleA" question: "If reflection precedes manifestation, what order must exist first?" - id: "Q-B" pole_ref: "CoreDuality.poleB" question: "If reflection precedes manifestation, how does flux reshape what appears?" - id: "Q-C" pole_ref: "RelatedDuality.poleC" question: "If reflection precedes manifestation, what must remain stable to reflect?" - id: "Q-D" pole_ref: "RelatedDuality.poleD" question: "If reflection precedes manifestation, when does reflection become becoming?" Cosmic & Mythic Structures Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns 3 · Master Key (Integrators) 4 · Linkage Scaffold SeedLayer.FundamentalLaw └─ CosmicForces ├─ MythicChronicles └─ DimensionalBoundaries ↪ feeds World & Geography module 5 · YAML Schema CosmicMythicModule: CosmicForces: - name: # string aspect: # abstract principle (e.g., "Entropy") domain: # realm or element governed CentralMyth: synopsis: # paragraph keyEvents: # list of pivotal moments DimensionalBoundaries: rules: # bullet list realmMap: # optional list of planes / realms 6 · Implementation Notes Coherence check – Any new realm or deity must reference CosmicForces.aspect or CentralMyth.keyEvents. Duality echo – Whenever possible, pair opposing CosmicForces with the poles of Core or Related Dualities. Tooling – If a legacy schema uses CosmicPrinciple: , map it to CentralMyth.synopsis for compatibility. 7 · Illustrative Example CosmicMythicModule: CosmicForces: - name: Lucent aspect: Clarity domain: Light & Memory - name: Umbral aspect: Obscurity domain: Shadow & Potential CentralMyth: synopsis: > From the Mirror of Origin, Lucent and Umbral emerged as twin reflections. Their dance birthed the first echo of space-time. keyEvents: - Shattering of the Mirror - Weaving of Realms DimensionalBoundaries: rules: - Reflection is required to cross realms. - Truth cannot pass untouched. realmMap: - Plane of Echoes - The Liminal Verge World & Geography Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns (unchanged) GeographicSymbolism · ResourceScarcity · ClimaticGradient (pattern table omitted here if you already have it in the doc—content remains the same) 3 · Master Key (Integrators) (unchanged) InterconnectedBiomes · MythicCorrespondence · SettlementEcology 4 · Linkage Scaffold (unchanged) SeedLayer → CosmicMythicModule.CentralMyth └─ MythicToponym ├─ BiomeSignature └─ ResourceNode → feeds Socio-Economic module 5 · YAML Schema WorldGeoModule: ContinentalMasses: - name: mythicToponym: biomeSignature: type: climaticGradient: ambientSensoryTrait: # e.g., "whisper-echo winds" resourceNodes: - type: abundance: GlobalPatterns: prevailingWinds: leyLines: migratoryRoutes: 6 · Implementation Notes Duality Echo – At least one ContinentalMass should physically embody a CoreDuality pole pair (e.g., luminous plains vs. shadow coast). Scalability – New regions must declare biomeSignature.type and reference which CosmicForce or Duality pole they resonate with. Map Hook – Coordinate or hex-grid index can be added for GIS / MythOS UI. Sensory Echo – ambientSensoryTrait must reuse a keyword (or close synonym) from the Seed’s SensoryLens. 7 · Illustrative Example WorldGeoModule: ContinentalMasses: - name: Lustram mythicToponym: "Land of First Light" biomeSignature: type: Glass-meadow Steppe climaticGradient: "Temperate → Arid toward the Obsidian Verge" ambientSensoryTrait: "prism-tint haze" resourceNodes: - type: MemoryQuartz abundance: high - name: Umbrafen mythicToponym: "Shadow-Reclaimed Marsh" biomeSignature: type: Bioluminescent Bog climaticGradient: "Humid — constant phosphor mist" ambientSensoryTrait: "low chorus of echo-frogs" resourceNodes: - type: Echo-Reeds abundance: medium GlobalPatterns: prevailingWinds: "East-to-west Zephyr carrying reflection spores" leyLines: "Tri-spoked lattice converging beneath the Mirror Rift" migratoryRoutes: - "Lucent Herd spiral path across Lustram" Culture & Civilisation Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns 3 · Master Key (Integrators) 4 · Linkage Scaffold WorldGeoModule.ContinentalMasses └─ CultureStrata ├─ ValueAxisCulture (mirrors Core / Related Dualities) ├─ RitualNodes (inherit CosmicForces symbolism) ├─ AestheticMemes (reflect BiomeSignature & resources) └─ SensoryPalette (echoes Seed’s SensoryLens) 5 · YAML Schema CultureCivModule: civilisations: - name: cultureStrata: - id: valueAxisCulture: # e.g., "Clarity-pursuit collectivism" populationEstimate: linguisticFamily: aestheticMemes: # list sensoryPalette: # NEW colour: [] sound: [] scent: [] ritualNodes: - name: cadence: # daily / seasonal / life-milestone mythicReference: exchangeNetwork: tradeRoutes: [] # pairs or paths pilgrimageWays: [] infoCircuits: [] 6 · Implementation Notes Duality Echo – At least one CultureStratum per region should lean to each Core/Related Duality pole. Resource Logic – A RitualNode that consumes scarce resources must reference its corresponding resourceNode.abundance. Sensory Consistency – Each sensoryPalette item should reuse a keyword from the Seed’s SensoryLens. Versioning – When a CultureStratum evolves, append generationTag (v1, v2…) to preserve historical layers. 7 · Illustrative Example CultureCivModule: civilisations: - name: Luminar Concord cultureStrata: - id: SolarArtisans valueAxisCulture: "Clarity-oriented individual mastery" populationEstimate: 1.2M linguisticFamily: "Heliatic" aestheticMemes: ["glass-filigree motifs", "sun-chime scales"] sensoryPalette: colour: ["sun-glass gold", "prism pink"] sound: ["soft chime"] scent: ["heated quartz"] ritualNodes: - name: Dawn-Mirror Rite cadence: daily mythicReference: "First Light’s reflection" - id: Glyph-Keepers valueAxisCulture: "Obscurity-embracing archivism" populationEstimate: 450k linguisticFamily: "Heliatic-Low" aestheticMemes: ["ink-veiled script", "shadow-calligraphy"] sensoryPalette: colour: ["smoke grey", "ink black"] sound: ["quiet rustle"] scent: ["dusty parchment"] ritualNodes: - name: Nocturne Scriptorium cadence: seasonal mythicReference: "Second Shattering" exchangeNetwork: tradeRoutes: ["Luminar ↔ Umbrafen (Quartz caravans)"] pilgrimageWays: ["Mirror Rift spiral"] infoCircuits: ["Echo-Reed whisper relays"] Socio-Political & Economic Systems Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns 3 · Master Key (Integrators) 4 · Linkage Scaffold CultureCivModule.civilisations.cultureStrata └─ ClassTiers ├─ PowerMatrix (formal + informal) ├─ EconomyMode (drives ResourceNode flow) └─ ConflictValve (mediates ValueAxis tensions) 5 · YAML Schema SocioPolEconModule: polities: - name: powerMatrix: governmentType: # council, empire, technocracy, etc. informalBlocs: [] # guilds, secret orders economyMode: primary: # gift / market / command / ritual keyCommodities: [] # list of ResourceNode types classTiers: # renamed from socialStrata - tier: basis: # birth / merit / ritual mark mobilityRules: ethicCodes: - principle: sourceMythicEvent: conflictValves: - type: # duel, debate, omen escalationLimit: interPolityRelations: alliances: [] # list of pairs rivalries: [] tradeAgreements:[] 6 · Implementation Notes Duality Echo – Highest and lowest ClassTiers often align to opposite poles of CoreDuality. Consistency Check – Any EconomyMode must reference a ResourceNode defined in WorldGeoModule. Dynamic Hook – When ResourceNode abundance changes, set economyMode.adjustmentNeeded: true for iterative update cycles. 7 · Illustrative Example SocioPolEconModule: polities: - name: Luminar Concord powerMatrix: governmentType: Council of Refractions informalBlocs: ["SolarArtisan Guild", "Glyph-Keeper Archivists"] economyMode: primary: market keyCommodities: ["MemoryQuartz", "Echo-Reeds"] classTiers: - tier: Radiant basis: mastery of light-craft mobilityRules: apprenticeship & merit trials - tier: Shadowbound basis: birth into archival families mobilityRules: can ascend via Mirror-Trial ethicCodes: - principle: "Illumination through service" sourceMythicEvent: "First Light’s reflection" conflictValves: - type: Dawn Duel escalationLimit: "first blood" interPolityRelations: alliances: ["Luminar Concord ↔ Glyph-Keepers"] rivalries: ["Luminar Concord ↔ Umbrafen Marsh-Lords"] tradeAgreements: ["Quartz-for-Reeds caravan pact"] Technology & Magic Frameworks Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns 3 · Master Key (Integrators) 4 · Linkage Scaffold ResourceNodes → PowerSources └─ TechDomain / MagicParadigm └─ ConstraintLaw → ties back to EthicCodes 5 · YAML Schema TechMagicModule: powerSources: - id: type: natural / synthetic / metaphysical abundance: high / medium / low constraintLaw: techDomains: - name: coreFunction: powerSourceRef: keyDevices: [] # list magicParadigms: - name: doctrine: powerSourceRef: signatureRites: [] # list synergyCircuits: - techDomainRef: magicParadigmRef: emergentEffect: 6 · Implementation Notes Balance Test – Every SynergyCircuit must include at least one complementary Duality pole. Escalation Guard – If a ConstraintLaw is breached, flag downstream modules for systemic instability. Versioning – Each paradigm or device can add rev: tags (v1, v2…) linking to the Future-Proofing module. 7 · Illustrative Example TechMagicModule: powerSources: - id: ReflectionFlux type: metaphysical abundance: medium constraintLaw: "Flux destabilises beyond the Mirror Rift" techDomains: - name: Luminal Engrams coreFunction: memory-imprint crystal recorders powerSourceRef: ReflectionFlux keyDevices: ["Engram Glass", "Echo-Stylus"] magicParadigms: - name: Mirror-Runecraft doctrine: carve sigils that redirect ReflectionFlux powerSourceRef: ReflectionFlux signatureRites: ["Shatter-Seal", "Echo-Bind"] synergyCircuits: - techDomainRef: Luminal Engrams magicParadigmRef: Mirror-Runecraft emergentEffect: "Self-updating sentient archives" Fine-Grained Cultural Details Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns 3 · Master Key (Integrators) 4 · Linkage Scaffold CultureCivModule.civilisations.cultureStrata └─ CultureDetails ├─ Foodways ├─ IdiomShards / MicroRituals └─ SymbolicArtifacts / FolkArtForms 5 · YAML Schema FineDetailModule: cultureDetails: - cultureStratumRef: foodways: - name: occasion: daily / festival / lifecycle keyIngredients: [] sensoryMotifs: [] # NEW optional idiomShards: - phrase: meaning: microRituals: - name: trigger: greeting / farewell / threshold symbolicLink: sensoryMotifs: [] # optional folkArtForms: - type: textile / song / dance / tattoo motif: # pattern or colour family sensoryMotifs: [] # optional symbolicArtifacts: - item: significance: materialOrigin: sensoryMotifs: [] # optional 6 · Implementation Notes Duality Echo – Idioms and micro-rituals should lean toward poles of Core or Related Duality. Sensory Consistency – Every sensoryMotifs entry should reuse terms from the Seed’s SensoryLens or the CultureStratum’s sensoryPalette. Version Tags – When a tradition evolves, append era: or rev: to preserve layered heritage. 7 · Illustrative Example FineDetailModule: cultureDetails: - cultureStratumRef: SolarArtisans foodways: - name: Prism-Broth occasion: festival keyIngredients: ["quartz-infused water", "sun-herbs"] sensoryMotifs: ["warm prismatic shimmer"] idiomShards: - phrase: "Catch the first glint" meaning: "Seize opportunity at dawn" microRituals: - name: Dawn-Palm Salute trigger: greeting symbolicLink: "First Light" sensoryMotifs: ["soft chime"] folkArtForms: - type: glass-filigree carving motif: "radiant spiral" sensoryMotifs: ["sun-glass gold"] symbolicArtifacts: - item: Sun-Chime significance: wards off reflective echoes materialOrigin: MemoryQuartz sensoryMotifs: ["bright resonance"] Characters & Local Stories Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns 3 · Master Key (Integrators) 4 · Linkage Scaffold CultureCivModule.civilisations.cultureStrata └─ Characters ├─ ContrastsOfPersona (align Core / Related Dualities) ├─ PersonalEcho (mirrors PrimaryTheme) ├─ ArtifactOfMemory (ties to RitualNodes or SymbolicArtifacts) └─ SignatureSense (echoes Seed’s SensoryLens) 5 · YAML Schema CharacterStoryModule: characters: - id: name: cultureStratumRef: # renamed role: protagonist / deuteragonist / foil / mentor signatureSense: # optional sensory hook contrastsOfPersona: poleInner: # e.g., Clarity-seeking poleShadow: # e.g., Fear of Obscurity personalEcho: # one-sentence theme reflection artifactOfMemory: item: origin: thematicLink: microTales: - title: synopsis: actHook: inciting / midpoint / resolution relationshipWeb: - charA: charB: bondType: ally / rival / kin / mentor tensionAxis: CoreDuality / RelatedDuality 6 · Implementation Notes Duality Check – Each contrastsOfPersona must reference Core or Related Duality poles. Theme Thread – personalEcho should reuse PrimaryTheme vocabulary to keep resonance obvious. Sensory Echo – signatureSense should quote a keyword from the Seed’s SensoryLens (or a clear synonym). Version Tags – When a character re-enters in a later timeline, add era: or rev: instead of overwriting. 7 · Illustrative Example CharacterStoryModule: characters: - id: Lira_Splitglass name: "Lira Split-glass" cultureStratumRef: SolarArtisans role: protagonist signatureSense: "faint scent of warmed quartz" contrastsOfPersona: poleInner: drive for pure Clarity poleShadow: fascination with Obscurity personalEcho: "She polishes every mirror until it fractures." artifactOfMemory: item: Shard-loom Pendant origin: crafted from the First Mirror splinter thematicLink: Reflection precedes manifestation microTales: - title: "The Echo Thief" synopsis: Lira bargains with a shadow-broker to retrieve stolen memories. actHook: inciting relationshipWeb: - charA: Lira_Splitglass charB: Archivist_Kai bondType: ally tensionAxis: CoreDuality Future-Proofing & Iteration Module 1 · Canonical Lexicon 2 · Core Patterns 3 · Master Key (Integrators) 4 · Linkage Scaffold AllModules.* └─ ModularNode (unique ID) └─ ChangelogEntry (when modified) └─ VersionControl.repo ↔ FeedbackLoop inputs ↪ may trigger EvolutionBranch if FundamentalLaw is breached 5 · YAML Schema FutureIterationModule: versionControl: repoURL: latestTag: changelog: - id: timestamp: editor: affectedNodes: [] # list of ModularNode IDs summary: reason: feedbackLoop: channels: [] # forum / survey / oracle-dream net reviewCycle: # quarterly / annual triageRules: modularNodes: - id: moduleRef: Seed / Duality / Cosmic / World / … # module name status: active / deprecated / branched lineage: parentID evolutionBranches: - branchID: triggerEvent: FundamentalLaw breach / player-vote / AI-analysis divergenceSummary: scheduledReviews: - date: scope: thematic / balance / factual 6 · Implementation Notes Immutable Guard – Attempting to edit PrimaryTheme or FundamentalLaw must create an evolutionBranches entry instead of overwriting. Impact Matrix – Each ChangelogEntry should list downstream nodes to update; MythOS can automate dependency checks. Transparency – Publish summaries of changes to community channels to maintain collaborative trust. 7 · Illustrative Example FutureIterationModule: versionControl: repoURL: "git://mirrorforge.univ" latestTag: v0.9.2 changelog: - id: CL-042 timestamp: 2025-05-21 editor: DawnWeaver affectedNodes: [LuminalEngrams, Mirror-Runecraft] summary: "Refined ConstraintLaw wording" reason: "Exploit created infinite Flux loop" feedbackLoop: channels: ["Echo-Forum", "Crystal Polls"] reviewCycle: "bi-annual" triageRules: "Urgent if exploits break ConstraintLaw" modularNodes: - id: Mirror-Runecraft moduleRef: magicParadigms status: active lineage: root evolutionBranches: - branchID: EB-001 triggerEvent: FundamentalLaw breach (ReflectionFlux overflow) divergenceSummary: "Shadow-Dominant Timeline" scheduledReviews: - date: 2026-01-01 scope: thematic Glossary Below is an alphabetical master glossary of every formal term defined in v1.0 of the Miroglyph Universe-Forge Manual.
